# Chulapa Jekyll theme

> Chulapa is a responsive Jekyll theme for blogs, portfolios, documentation and project sites. It uses Bootstrap and supports GitHub Pages and other Jekyll hosts.

The documentation is the source of truth for installation, configuration, layouts and supported integrations. Configure the site in `_config.yml` and use page front matter or Jekyll defaults for page options. Extend the theme through existing layouts, includes and assets.

The documentation also covers v2.1.1-dev changes available on main after v2.1.0. Mermaid diagrams, PhotoSwipe galleries, GoatCounter analytics and the accessibility and resource-loading improvements are not included in the v2.1.0 gem or pinned remote theme. Check each page's version caveats and the theme version used by the site before applying its advice. Some integrations require third-party services, and accessibility depends on the site's content, skin and customizations as well as the theme.

## Getting started

- [Documentation overview](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs): Task-oriented documentation index with Tutorials, How-To Guides, Reference and separate Explanation pages.
- [Start a site](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/00-start): Browser-only tutorial: publish the Chulapa 101 blog with a personal title and edited sample article; existing task/example anchors remain as compatibility links.
- [Installation](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/01-install): Method directory linking the first-site tutorial, remote-theme and gem setup guides, and migration checklist.
- [Migrating from another theme](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/07-migration): Pinned remote-theme migration procedure, task links, preserved URLs and a twelve-point checklist; separate field-mapping reference.
- [Global settings](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/02-config): Option reference for site identity, navbar/footer, metadata, search, comments, analytics (Google and development GoatCounter), collections, Jekyll build settings and HTML compression; site identity and menu/footer editing have separate task guides.

- [Change site details](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/14-site-details): Update title, description and author, match the existing home-page heading and preserve site addresses.
- [Add or change a menu link](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/10-edit-menu): Edit an existing site’s navbar links, preserve other navigation settings and verify destinations with baseurl.
- [Edit footer links](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/11-edit-footer): Update contact, social and feed destinations while keeping existing footer settings.

- [Enable Fuse.js search](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/12-fusejs-search): Configure the provider and matching search page, avoid duplicate output paths and verify indexed results.
- [Enable giscus comments](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/13-giscus-comments): Configure the embed and provider, enable one post and verify GitHub Discussions.

- [Create a post](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/15-create-post): Create a dated article, publish it and check its public listing and address.
- [Create a page](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/16-create-page): Create a standalone page, preserve its address and add a menu link.
- [Add an image](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/17-add-image): Upload an image, use relative_url and check the published result.

- [Enable GoatCounter](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/18-goatcounter): Configure the HTTPS counting endpoint, production build and visit checks; requires main after v2.1.0.
- [Enable Google Analytics 4](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/19-google-analytics): Configure a measurement ID, avoid duplicate snippets and verify reporting.

- [Install a remote theme](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/20-remote-theme): Configure a pinned release, merge runtime dependencies and plugins, preview and publish.
- [Install the theme gem](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/21-gem-theme): Install the released gem, enable include-cache, preview, publish and update.

## Theme and content reference

- [Theming](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/03-theming): Appearance fields, defaults, accepted values and constraints, with links to separate tasks and a precedence explanation.
- [Layouts and snippets](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/04-layouts): Links to post, page and image task guides; layout and page options, galleries, video, TOCs, MathJax, Mermaid and PhotoSwipe, with complete snippet parameters, a theme-managed helper inventory and practical guidance for local overrides.
- [Migration field mappings](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/46-migration-fields): Lookup for legacy layout/front matter patterns, site integration fields, local overrides and pinned-version constraints.
- [Starter examples reference](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/08-starter-examples): Four minimal Jekyll source examples, annotated demos, dependency list, contents and limitations; no deployment workflow.
- [Run a starter example](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/09-run-starter): Copy, configure, preview and publish a minimal example for existing Jekyll users.
- [Variables dictionary](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/variable-dictionary): Selected variable identifiers, mapping syntax, value types and constraints; editing steps are in the color/font guides.
- [Markdown cheatsheet](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/markdown-cheatsheet): Markdown and kramdown syntax, tables, code and TOCs.
- [Syntax highlighting](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/syntax-highlighting): Style identifiers, configuration mapping specimens and interactive code previews; saving steps are in Change code highlighting.

## Troubleshooting and site checks

- [Frequently asked questions](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/05-faq): Browser editing and publishing, formatting, favicons, skin previews, troubleshooting and built-in feeds.
- [Accessibility and performance](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/06-accessibility-performance): How-To Guide for checking published pages with keyboard navigation, enlarged text, media and real resources; links to separate behavior/limit reference.

## Optional

- [Chulapa v2.1.0 overview](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/blog/20261009_chulapa-v2-1-0): Released features, configuration examples and upgrade steps, with a separately labeled development preview.
- [Demos](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/demo): Working examples of layouts and integrations.
- [Skins](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/skins): Skin previews and available choices.
- [Chulapa 101](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa-101): Editable personal-blog template with GitHub Pages publishing workflows.
- [Minimal example sources](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa/tree/main/examples): Source files for the four starter examples.
- [Documentation sources](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa/tree/main/docs/collections/_docs): Markdown sources for the documentation pages.
- [Theme source](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa): Theme implementation and development history.

## Appearance tasks and explanation

- [Choose a skin](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/22-choose-skin): Apply a named skin while preserving existing overrides.
- [Change a color](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/23-change-color): Edit one supported variable and check component contrast.
- [Change fonts](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/24-change-fonts): Load a stylesheet and apply body/heading families.
- [Code highlighting](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/25-code-highlighting): Apply a highlighting stylesheet and check code blocks.
- [Appearance precedence](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/26-appearance-precedence): Explain skins, vars, generated defaults and local overrides.
- [Enable Autothemer](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/27-autothemer): Generate undefined colors while retaining assigned values.
- [Adapt a Sass skin](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/28-custom-skin): Preview and translate Sass assignments, or use a local skin; retain Bootstrap/grid constraints.

## Media tasks

- [Add a photo gallery](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/29-add-gallery): Group uploaded images and display them in filename order; the selected sort field requires main after v2.1.0 or a later release containing the sorting fix.
- [Add a manual slideshow](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/30-add-carousel): Reuse an image group with keyboard-operable carousel controls; filename ordering and native keyboard-operable buttons/indicators require main after v2.1.0 or a later release containing those fixes.
- [Enable PhotoSwipe](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/31-photoswipe): Enable a viewer on an existing gallery; requires main after v2.1.0.
- [Embed a video](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/32-embed-video): Add a named YouTube player and verify preview and playback.
- [Add a Mermaid diagram](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/33-add-diagram): Enable page rendering and add an accessible flowchart; requires main after v2.1.0.

## Other search providers

- [Enable Lunr.js](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/34-lunr-search): Configure a local provider, reuse the search page and verify the built index.
- [Enable Simple-Jekyll-Search](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/35-simplesearch-search): Switch local search without a service account or extra plugin.
- [Connect Google Custom Search](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/36-google-search): Use an existing engine ID and verify scope and external indexing.
- [Connect Algolia](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/37-algolia-search): Configure browser credentials and separate index uploads; indexing keys stay private and the indexing plugin is deprecated.

## Comment-provider tasks

- [Connect Disqus](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/38-disqus-comments): Reuse an existing shortname, enable one post and check thread matching.
- [Connect Cactus](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/39-cactus-comments): Reuse the hosted service with the required local conversation-ID correction and existing-thread checks; conditional resource loading requires main after v2.1.0.
- [Connect Welcomments](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/40-welcomments-comments): Preserve theme templates, configure the website ID and verify delivered comment data after a rebuild; project sites need the documented form permalink correction.
- [Connect self-hosted Cusdis](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/41-cusdis-comments): Reconnect an existing host/application; upstream is archived and the original hosted service is unavailable.

## Troubleshooting and custom hooks

- [Find missing changes](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/42-unpublished-changes): Check saved commits, publishing/deployment runs, public addresses and post dates.
- [Fix YAML errors](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/43-yaml-errors): Locate the failed edit, correct syntax and distinguish parsing from unsupported settings.
- [Add HTML to the head](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/44-custom-head): Append a snippet without copying a layout; verify the published HTML.
- [Custom hooks reference](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/45-custom-hooks): Supported paths, insertion order, CSS front matter and override constraints.

## Publishing and accessibility

- [How publishing fits together](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/47-publishing-explained): Explanation of source files, builds, deployment and hosting; why saving differs from publication.
- [Accessibility and resource-loading reference](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/48-accessibility-reference): Supported development behaviors, version boundaries, offline limitations and review scope; not a site compliance claim.

## Article formatting tasks

- [Add an alert box](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/49-add-alert): Place kramdown paragraph attributes, choose information/warning styling and check the published box.
- [Add a caption](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/50-add-caption): Add a styled caption beneath an image without replacing its alternative text.
- [Add a footnote](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/51-add-footnote): Use matching labels and verify generated forward/return links.

## Site icons and bundled font

- [Add a favicon](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/52-add-favicon): Upload icon files, preserve head snippets and verify explicit links with baseurl; manifests do not provide offline capability.
- [Use the Chulapa font](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/53-chulapa-font): Apply the bundled family and ligatures to headings or use its existing class on selected text.

## Icons and version checks

- [Add a Font Awesome icon](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/54-add-icon): Insert a free icon with accompanying text and diagnose missing icons without duplicate loaders.
- [Check the theme version](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/55-check-theme-version): Inspect remote tags, resolved gem versions and published markers without treating them as exact unpinned commits.

## Subscription feeds

- [Publish posts in built-in feeds](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/56-publish-feeds): Merge post defaults, preserve explicit exclusions and verify subscription URLs with baseurl.
- [Keep a jekyll-feed address](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/57-jekyll-feed): Preserve subscribers, avoid output collisions and distinguish plugin selection from theme feed settings.

## Content indexes

- [Add a content table of contents](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/58-content-toc): Place a kramdown index of article-wide headings, set levels and verify links; its settings differ from the theme TOC but .no_toc exclusions are shared.

## Second guided exercise

- [Publish an illustrated page](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/59-photo-page-tutorial): After first publication, create a fixed photo page and menu link in the browser using the existing starter image.

## Publisher metadata

- [Identify a personal site's publisher](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/60-person-publisher): Set Person in the existing publisher mapping and inspect JSON-LD without changing article authors; supported since v2.1.0.

## Date localization

- [Display an article date in another language](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/61-localize-date): Format a dated object's value, translate month/weekday names and verify the result; site locale does not translate the entire interface.

## Republished articles

- [Set an article's original URL](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/62-canonical-article): Configure canonical metadata, preserve the copy's address and check jekyll-sitemap exclusion and feed links.

## Content discovery and metadata tasks

- [Tag/category indexes](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/63-tag-category-clouds): Create grouped post lists and connect article badges; live demos retain their actual collection choices.
- [Post sharing metadata](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/64-post-sharing): Set description/social image/article illustration values and inspect published tags; reference retains fallback rules.
- [Search visibility](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/65-search-visibility): Apply independent crawler, sitemap and local-search exclusions; Algolia needs separate indexing configuration.
